title: Looks a little fake
text: Looks a little fake. I was expecting heavy cast iron like from a railroad tie or skillet. This candle holder is doesn’t have that look or feel. It looks like it has bubbles in the iron that were there when the item was cooled. Almost like a pumace stone. The shape is cool. The paint job is okay. Holds a taper candle. It doesn’t wobble when on a flat surface. Only 1 candle holder comes!!

product_metadata.title: Creative Co-Op Cast Iron Taper, Black Candle Holder
features: Cast iron taper holder, trendy, rustic, and eclectic, definitely not your run of the mill candlestick
